August

everything seem to dust away,
and i search myself in their words
do i have to walk all the path?

And maybe that's what August is;
the moment between holding on
and yearning to let go,
between who we were
and who we're becoming.

Maybe not.

And a gentle reminder
that growing doesn't always have to hurt,
that some things just naturally leaves
only to make room for something bigger,
and that not every goodbye is a loss.

when we finally stop looking for it
and let August remind you,
not everything that ends
was meant to be lost.
